intro.text: A fungus on Patji's trees with dangerous spores, which trappers sometimes grow to guard their camps; water keeps the spores from escaping.

description.text: Touched, it bursts out deadly spores to defend itself; smothering it in water keeps them in.

items.text: Dusk cultivated a patch for years; on her way to his safecamp, Vathi recognized it and doused it with water, making its spores harmless.
Nightwind near the mouth of the cave on Dakwara's island helped Dusk see the pattern in the cave's dangers.
